resources.string: Pick a name to call your character.

Your character sleeps when Do Not Disturb turns on and wakes when it turns off. Set up a bedtime schedule in the Clock app and Do Not Disturb will turn on and off automatically every day — so your character sleeps and wakes on a regular rhythm too.
Not enough recent sleep records. After a few nights of sleep, we can match it.
Auto-detection is off. Only the times set above will be used.

We can\'t read your device\'s Do Not Disturb right now, so your character only sleeps at the times set above. To have it follow your sleep mode: Settings > Sound & vibration > Do Not Disturb > turn on a bedtime schedule. (If you have sleep records in Health Connect, it follows those automatically.)
Your device\'s Do Not Disturb and sleep records come first; if none is available, the time you set above is used. When Do Not Disturb is on during sleep hours, your character goes to sleep.
Your character will be shown eating for 30 minutes from the time you set.
When weather is available, the sun and moon switch automatically with the real sunrise and sunset times. The times you set here are only used when your location is unknown.
You can decide which character shows for each state. Tap to open that state\'s gallery folder.
For characters made as animated, choose whether to show them moving. Turn it off to show a single image and save battery.
e.g. a pink bunny, a roly-poly character with big eyes
This sentence is auto-filled when creating your character. Writing in English gives better results.
